results.title: Complex Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder in Refugees, Asylum Seekers, and Internal
results.reason: This systematic review and meta-analysis directly addresses **complex post-traumatic stress disorder (CPTSD)** in **forcibly displaced populations** (refugees, asylum seekers, internally displaced people), which has significant clinical relevance for practitioners working with trauma populations.
results.authors: Mamaru Melkam; Xu Cheng; Fiona Maccallum; Lena Oestreich

results.title: Measuring workplace fear of missing out in French-speaking employees: psychometr
results.reason: This paper examines workplace fear of missing out (wFoMO), a technology-related workplace stressor with implications for mental health and wellbeing. It focuses on psychometric validation of assessment tools for adult employees in a clinical context, making it relevant to clinical psychology practice.
results.authors: Sara Badertscher; Raphaël Semaan; Urs Nater; Raphael Heinzer; José Haba-Rubio; Peter Vlerick; Patrick Gomez

results.title: Advancing Behavioral Avoidance Assessment: A Refined Psychometric Framework to M
results.reason: The paper presents a psychometric framework for assessing avoidance behavior, which is a central transdiagnostic coping strategy in psychopathology with direct relevance to clinical practice for therapists and psychologists working with various mental disorders.
results.authors: Nico Remmert; Sewon Oh; Svetlana Shinkareva; Silia Vitoratou; Jane Gregory; Robert Wilhelm Krause; Steffi Pohl

results.title: Hunger as an uncontroversial predictor of poor adolescent mental health: evidenc
results.reason: This paper directly examines the relationship between hunger and mental health outcomes in adolescents, with clear clinical implications for understanding risk factors for psychological distress and suicidality across diverse global settings.
results.authors: Mirela Zaneva; Tsvetomira Dumbalska; Aaron Reeves; Lucy Bowes

results.title: Group-Based Factors in Survivors’ Migration and Post-Disaster Recovery
results.reason: The paper examines post-disaster recovery through a social psychology lens, focusing on trauma, psychological well-being, and mental health interventions after displacement, which has direct relevance to clinical psychology practice.
results.authors: İlknur Tayınmak; Selin Tekin; John Drury; Huriye Gözde Türel; Cansu Öz
